name: Tulsi Leaves - 70gms. Organic Herbal Immunity booster.
original_description:
### Organic Tulsi Leaves – 70g | Pure, Sun-Dried & Hand-Selected

Celebrate the sacred presence of Ocimum sanctum—known in Ayurveda as Tulsi, the “Incomparable One.” For millennia, this revered herb has been nurtured in Indian homesteads, not merely as a plant, but as a symbol of harmony, devotion, and natural rhythm.

Our Organic Tulsi Leaves are hand-harvested at dawn from pesticide-free farms across India’s fertile regions. Gently sun-dried under open skies and meticulously sorted by skilled hands, each leaf retains its natural fragrance, subtle peppery warmth, and earthy hue—untouched by chemicals, sulfites, or artificial processes.

Packaged in a resealable, eco-friendly pouch, this 70g offering is crafted for those who honor tradition. Whether used in daily herbal infusions, as part of morning rituals, or simply to fill a space with its calming aroma, Tulsi invites stillness and presence.

Why Our Tulsi Leaves?
- Grown organically, without synthetic inputs
- Hand-sorted and air-dried to preserve natural character
- Certified organic, non-GMO, and free from chemical residues
- Ethically sourced from small farms rooted in Ayurvedic heritage

A herb of ancient Vedic lore, Tulsi continues to be woven into the fabric of daily life—not for what it does, but for the quiet grace it brings.

Ritual Suggestion:
Place 1–2 teaspoons of leaves in a cup. Pour hot (not boiling) water over them. Allow to steep for 5–7 minutes. Enjoy warm, as a moment of pause in your day.

---
